name: Marriage And Family
overview: Scripture reveals that marriage is a divine institution designed for companionship and unity, as God created a suitable helper for man and established that a man shall leave his parents and unite with his wife to become one flesh. Finding a wife is described as a good and favorable blessing from the Lord. Husbands are called to love their wives sacrificially, just as Christ loved the church, while wives are instructed to respect their husbands. Marriage is honored by God as a pure and sacred covenant, with unfaithfulness subject to His judgment.
